limitations: Original artwork has no recoverable body colors or contour directly underneath opaque white strokes. These pixels are locally interpolated; they are not claimed as original pixels.
No body recoloring, scaling, contour redesign or generative texture is used. RGB is byte-identical outside the exported repair mask.
At arm-body intersections a few subpixel contour segments are inferred from immediately adjacent original contours; the inferred-contour and alpha-change masks identify them.
method: Original RGBA pixels; local biharmonic arm inpainting, robust cubic neighboring-color face interpolation with a 5-pixel internal feather, and original-adjacent contour inference only at former arm crossings.
visual_qa: Inspected full canvas on light and dark backgrounds; inspected face and former hand/arm areas at 3x resolution. No white flecks, alpha pinholes, recognizable old face ghosts, or arm protrusions remain.
header_use: Embedded unchanged as the only body image; separate existing SVG face and hand paths preserve articulation. No body outline or rim strokes.
